verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a broad API surface: a Video API for scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation and templates; an Upload API; a Localization API; a Billing API; an Interactive Avatars API; webhooks; and an MCP server. That covers the core video-generation workflow programmatically. However, nothing shows UI parity for many UI features, so programmatic coverage is substantial but clearly not 'everything'. Missing for 10: documented API access to avatar creation, brand kits, interactive videos (branching and quizzes), AI roleplay, collaboration and review workflows, screen recording and SCORM export, plus any explicit parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
Upload API (V2) — upload your own image/video assets or custom script audio (e.g. your own text-to-speech) for use when creating Video API videos.
Billing API — retrieve your workspace's current billing period and credit balance programmatically.
Localization API — localize your videos into up to 20 languages per request.
You can also use Synthesia MCP to create and find videos from AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, without calling an API yourself.
Developers can use the Interactive Avatars API to connect a Synthesia avatar to their existing AI agent
